This indicates that Acronyculatin E may influence the activity of Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP through a chain of molecular interactions. The scores from the two paths, while not perfectly aligned, suggest a consistent pattern of target engagement, though the strength of the relationship is somewhat weaker in the second path. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Acronyculatin E and Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP.
